label: Instructional Item 2
stem: Matt, Sara, Jamie, and Alex measured the length of their classroom with different units. Matt measured in feet, Sara measured in centimeters, Jamie measured in inches, and Alex measured in yards. Whose unit of measure would be the most appropriate to use when measuring the length of the classroom?

option letters A B C D
